h1: Atyrau NDT ERP Software — Tengiz and Karachaganak Ready
localHook: Atyrau is the command city of Kazakhstan's upstream oil industry and home to some of the most technically demanding NDT scope on the planet. Tengizchevroil (TCO) — the Chevron, ExxonMobil, KazMunayGas and LukArco joint venture — runs the Tengiz sour-crude supergiant with Future Growth Project and Wellhead Pressure Management Project now producing, pushing H2S levels and mercaptan exposure that dictate material selection and every NDT technique used. Karachaganak Petroleum Operating (Shell, Eni, Chevron, Lukoil, KMG) handles the gas-condensate giant, while NCOC operates the massive offshore Kashagan field. The KazMunayGas-owned Atyrau Refinery, at around 110,000 barrels per day after its modernization, anchors downstream scope, and the CPC Atyrau pumping station feeds crude to Novorossiysk. Inspectors juggle API 510, 570 and 653 with adopted Kazakh ST RK and still-referenced Russian GOST 34347 pressure equipment rules, and NACE MR0175 sour-service compliance is non-negotiable. Atlantis NDT ERP brings API, GOST, ST RK and NACE records into one bilingual Russian-and-English Atyrau tenant.
integrationPainParagraph: TCO, KPO and NCOC run SAP S/4HANA at the enterprise level with IBM Maximo for plant-floor work orders and Oracle EBS for finance, while KazMunayGas and the Atyrau Refinery run their own Maximo and SAP instances aligned with KMG group standards. Turnaround campaigns add Primavera P6 schedules from Worley, Fluor and Bonatti. NDT records, PAUT maps, H2S exposure logs and calibration data rarely cross these boundaries cleanly, and Kazakhstan's Ministry of Energy and Committee for Industrial Development audits surface the gap. Atlantis NDT ERP writes inspection findings into SAP PM notifications and Maximo work orders via REST, syncs turnaround hold-points with Primavera P6, and maintains ST RK, GOST and NACE MR0175 sour-service traceability so Kazakh regulator and JV partner submissions happen from one record in Russian and English.
remoteDeliveryPitch: Atlantis deploys into Atyrau without flying consultants into Kazakhstan. Discovery runs entirely over Teams in Russian and English, SAP and Maximo connectors configure cleanly against a CIS sandbox tenant, and technicians train in recorded Russian-language sessions aligned to TCO, KPO and NCOC rotation schedules across the Caspian basin. Most Atyrau rollouts go live in 6 to 8 weeks, with dedicated hypercare timed around Tengiz and Karachaganak turnarounds.
